headline.title: Clio’s $500M milestone arrives just as Anthropic ups the ante
headline.summary: Clio has achieved a significant milestone by reaching $500 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR), reflecting strong customer adoption in the legal tech sector. This growth comes as competition intensifies, particularly with Anthropic increasing its efforts in the AI space.

articles.title: Meta’s New Reality: Record High Profits. Record Low Morale
articles.summary: Meta is set to reduce its workforce by approximately 10 percent next week, amid reports of low employee morale despite achieving record high profits. Interviews with current and former employees reveal a pervasive sense of unhappiness within the company.

articles.title: The shock of seeing your body used in deepfake porn
articles.summary: A woman named Jennifer discovered that her professional headshot was linked to deepfake porn videos from her past when she tested a facial recognition program. This incident highlights the ongoing issues of privacy and consent in the age of deepfake technology.

articles.title: High-Rate Quantized Matrix Multiplication II
articles.summary: The article "High-Rate Quantized Matrix Multiplication II" explores quantized matrix multiplication with a focus on scenarios where the covariance matrix of the second factor's columns is known. This research is particularly relevant for weight-only post-training quantization in large language models (LLMs).

articles.title: Who decides what AI tells you? Campbell Brown, once Meta’s news chief, has thoughts
articles.summary: Campbell Brown, former news chief at Meta, highlights the disconnect between discussions in Silicon Valley about AI content and the perspectives of consumers. She emphasizes the need for clearer communication and understanding of AI's role in shaping information dissemination.

articles.title: AI chatbots are giving out people’s real phone numbers
articles.summary: Reports have emerged that AI chatbots, including those from Google, are inadvertently disclosing users' personal phone numbers, leading to unsolicited calls from strangers. Affected individuals are finding it difficult to prevent their contact information from being exposed.

articles.title: Musk’s xAI is running nearly 50 gas turbines unchecked at its Mississippi data center
articles.summary: Musk's xAI is operating nearly 50 gas turbines at its Colossus 2 data center in Mississippi without regulatory oversight, leading to a lawsuit regarding the classification of these "mobile" gas turbines as power plants. The legal action highlights concerns over the environmental and operational implications of the facility's energy sourcing.

articles.title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
articles.summary: The article introduces Ego2World, a new framework that compiles egocentric cooking videos into executable environments for embodied agents, enabling belief-state planning in household settings. This approach addresses the limitations of existing benchmarks by integrating realistic human activities with interactive simulations, thereby reducing the sim-to-real gap.

articles.title: 3D Primitives are a Spatial Language for VLMs
articles.summary: A recent study highlights the effectiveness of 3D geometric primitives as an intermediate representation for vision-language models (VLMs), which can generate executable code to reconstruct 3D scenes accurately. Despite this capability, VLMs struggle with simpler spatial questions related to the same images, indicating a paradox in their spatial understanding.

articles.title: Controlling Logical Collapse in LLMs via Algebraic Ontology Projection over F2
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced Algebraic Ontology Projection (AOP) to analyze how large language models (LLMs) encode ontological relations using a formal algebraic structure. AOP demonstrates high accuracy in zero-shot inclusion of unseen concept pairs, achieving up to 93.33% accuracy with a limited set of relational pairs.

articles.title: Neural QAOA$^{2}$: Differentiable Joint Graph Partitioning and Parameter Initialization for Quantum Combinatorial Optimization
articles.summary: The article introduces Neural QAOA², a method that enhances the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) for combinatorial optimization by addressing limitations in graph partitioning and parameter initialization. This approach aims to improve scalability and alignment with quantum optimization goals by utilizing differentiable joint graph partitioning techniques.

articles.title: Context Matters: Auditing Gender Bias in T2I Generation through Risk-Tiered Use-Case Profiles
articles.summary: The article discusses the need for auditing gender bias in text-to-image (T2I) generative models, which are increasingly utilized in various sectors such as education and media. It highlights the potential for these models to reinforce stereotypes and suggests the development of risk-tiered use-case profiles to better assess and mitigate gender bias in generated content.
